design.quote: Participants were randomly assigned to eat a control diet or the DASH diet

population.value: adults with ambulatory blood pressure monitoring, 58% self-reported Black

primary_findings.quote: reduced mean (95%CI) awake SBP by 9.0 mmHg (6.4, 11.7) in Black participants
primary_findings.outcome: awake systolic blood pressure reduction in Black participants

primary_findings.quote: reduced mean (95%CI) awake SBP by 7.5 mmHg (4.5, 10.6) in Non-Black participants
primary_findings.outcome: awake systolic blood pressure reduction in Non-Black participants

primary_findings.quote: mean asleep SBP by 8.0 mmHg (4.8, 11.2) in Black participants
primary_findings.outcome: asleep systolic blood pressure reduction in Black participants

primary_findings.quote: mean asleep SBP by 7.4 mmHg (3.9,11.0) in Non-Black participants
primary_findings.outcome: asleep systolic blood pressure reduction in Non-Black participants
